extracted.intended_audience: agency staff (State Board of Elections), regulated entities, and members of the public who submit or manage public comments on Virginia rulemaking
extracted.subtask_description: Rules governing how the agency and board must provide, accept, and manage public comment during regulation adoption in Virginia, including required materials, accepted formats, minimum comment periods for various types of actions, and discretion to alter periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority to commence regulation adoption
rubrics_metrics.description: Whenever directed by statute or upon its own initiative, the agency may commence the regulation adoption process and proceed to draft a proposal according to these procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes that the agency has the statutory or discretionary authority to begin rulemaking and to follow the prescribed procedural steps for drafting a proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligation to afford opportunity to submit data, views, and arguments
rubrics_metrics.description: In considering any nonemergency, exempt regulatory action, the board shall afford interested persons an opportunity to submit data, views, and arguments, either orally or in writing, to the agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to nonemergency, exempt regulatory actions; ensures both oral and written comment opportunities are provided to interested persons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online public comment forum requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Such opportunity to comment shall include an online public comment forum on Town Hall or through the State Board of Elections website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies acceptable online platforms for public comment (Town Hall or the board's website) as part of the required opportunities to comment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to obtain supporting regulatory materials on request
rubrics_metrics.description: To any requesting person, the agency shall provide copies of the statement of basis, purpose, substance, and issues; any economic impact analysis of the proposed regulatory action; and the agency's response to public comments received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures transparency by requiring the agency to supply key explanatory and analytical documents and the agency's responses to comments to anyone who requests them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency may draft before or during public comment
rubrics_metrics.description: The agency may begin crafting a regulatory action prior to or during any opportunities it provides to the public to submit comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies that preparatory drafting by the agency is permitted before and while public comment periods are open; does not prohibit ongoing internal development concurrent with public input.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance of written public comments after publication (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: The agency shall accept public comments in writing after the publication of a regulatory action either on its website or on Town Hall and in the Virginia Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes where public comments will be accepted following publication: agency website or Town Hall and the Virginia Register.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum comment period for proposed exempt regulatory actions
rubrics_metrics.description: For a minimum of 21 calendar days following the publication of the notice of proposed exempt regulatory action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the baseline statutory minimum duration for comment on proposed exempt regulatory actions: 21 calendar days from publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum comment period for reproposed regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: For a minimum of 21 calendar days following the publication of a reproposed regulation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires at least 21 calendar days for public comment after a reproposal is published.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commenting on proposed emergency regulations (to extent possible)
rubrics_metrics.description: To the extent reasonably possible following the publication of a proposed emergency regulation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acknowledges that for emergency regulations the agency should accept comments after publication as practicable given the emergency context; no fixed minimum stated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum comment period for notice of periodic review
rubrics_metrics.description: For a minimum of 21 calendar days following the publication of a notice of periodic review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires at least a 21-calendar-day comment period for notices that a regulation will be subject to periodic review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment period following a petition for rulemaking
rubrics_metrics.description: Not later than 21 calendar days following the publication of a petition for rulemaking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies that written comments must be accepted no later than 21 days after publication of a petition for rulemaking (i.e., ensures a comment window exists tied to petition publication).

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency discretion to extend or reduce comment periods
rubrics_metrics.description: The agency may determine if any of the comment periods listed in subsection C of this section shall be extended or reduced if necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grants the agency flexibility to lengthen or shorten the enumerated comment periods when necessary; implies case-by-case adjustment based on circumstances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional comment period when substantial changes occur
rubrics_metrics.description: If the board finds that one or more changes with substantial impact have been made to a proposed regulation, the board, in its discretion, may allow an additional period of time to solicit additional public comment on the changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Protects against materially altered proposals being adopted without further input by allowing the board to reopen or extend comment when substantial-impact changes are made.
